facts.text: Pirules Garden Kitchen offers wood-fired dining led by Chef Odin Rocha, using ingredients sourced from local producers.
facts.excerpt: A wood-fired dining experience led by Chef Odín Rocha, blending ancestral techniques, seasonal creativity, and ingredients sourced from local producers.

facts.text: Luna Rooftop draws inspiration from Mediterranean cuisine while celebrating Mexican ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from Mediterranean cuisine whilst celebrating the richness of Mexican ingredients, discover the best of both worlds at Luna Rooftop.

facts.text: 1826 Restaurant serves modern interpretations of Mexican culinary heritage with indoor or al fresco dining.
facts.excerpt: Savor modern interpretations of Mexico's culinary heritage at 1826 Restaurant, featuring regional flavors, local ingredients, and indoor or al fresco dining options.

facts.text: The Parroquia Suite is a one-bedroom suite with dual fireplaces and a terrace with views of San Miguel's church.
facts.excerpt: One-bedroom luxury suite with dual fireplaces and terrace with breathtaking views of San Miguel’s iconic church

facts.text: Colonial Rooms have a bathroom with a soaking tub and a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a king or two queen beds, a bathroom with soaking tub, and a private balcony perfect for cocktails, stargazing, and taking in the view.

facts.text: Junior Suites feature wood floors, natural stone hearths, artwork and an outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by local artisans, these suites feature residential style with elegant décor, wood floors, natural stone hearths, artwork, and an outdoor terrace.

facts.text: Rooms use locally crafted furniture and hand-carved finishes.
facts.excerpt: Locally crafted furniture, hand-carved finishes and warm tones reflect San Miguel’s soul in every detail

facts.text: A horseback ride descends into a canyon and ends at a natural river.
facts.excerpt: Journey through one of San Miguel de Allende's most stunning terrains on horseback, descending into a canyon and ending at a natural river.

facts.text: A Mojigangas workshop experience lets guests create their own miniature Mojigangas figure at a traditional workshop in San Miguel de Allende.
facts.excerpt: This cultural experience will take you to the most traditional workshop in San Miguel de Allende to create your own miniature version of Mojigangas figures.

facts.excerpt: A steam room and sauna are reasons to arrive pre-treatment, and relaxation rooms make the case for lingering.
